name: Mantle Cell Lymphoma
remarks: Mantle cell lymphoma (MCL): a rare, male-predominant mature B-cell
non-Hodgkin lymphoma defined by t(11;14)(q13;q32) and cyclin D1
overexpression. Median age at diagnosis ~68; most patients present with
advanced-stage (III/IV) disease.
INCIDENCE. Annual reroll from age 50: 1.5e-05/yr for males, 5e-06/yr for
everyone else -- a population-average 1e-05/yr carrying the ~3:1
male:female ratio consistently reported for MCL. US MCL incidence is
~0.5-0.8 per 100,000 person-years across all ages and rises steeply after
age 60, so restricting the hazard to age 50+ concentrates the same case
count into the genuinely at-risk band and yields a median age at diagnosis
in the high 60s. Sources: Teras LR et al., 'US lymphoid malignancy
statistics by World Health Organization subtypes', CA Cancer J Clin
2016;66:443-459 (MCL ~0.5/100,000/yr, male:female ~2.8:1); SEER*Explorer
NHL-subtype incidence tables (MCL ~0.8/100,000/yr in recent years).
The pre-fix module rolled 8e-05 x 0.3 exactly once, at exactly age 45, and
only for white males -- a single-age spike with no reroll and a 30-50x
shortfall against the literature.
ENCOUNTERS. Every clinical state runs inside an encounter that is
explicitly closed before any Delay of a day or more. All chemotherapy,
immunotherapy and trial follow-up is modelled as closed per-cycle or
per-visit encounters (open -> administer/observe -> EncounterEnd ->
inter-cycle Delay). Transplant, CAR-T and hyper-CVAD are inpatient
admissions with a bounded length of stay and an explicit EncounterEnd.
The pre-fix module held Clinical_Trial_Treatment open across a 6-18 month
Delay and Salvage_Chemotherapy open across a 3-9 month Delay (two lint
CRITICALs), and ran the whole second-line arm with no encounter open at
all -- administrations there were silently attributed to whatever stale
encounter happened to be the person's most recent.
MEDICATIONS. Infusional agents (rituximab, bendamustine, cyclophosphamide,
doxorubicin, vincristine, dexamethasone, etoposide, gemcitabine) are
administration:true, which both routes them to the J-code/HCPCS export and
makes duplicate concurrent orders impossible. The single fixed-course oral
(R-CHOP prednisone, 5 days per cycle) is ordered per cycle and explicitly
MedicationEnd-ed five days later. Continuous oral targeted agents
(ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, venetoclax) are chronic:true, attribute-guarded
so a monitoring loop cannot re-order them, and MedicationEnd-ed when the
patient moves to the next line of therapy. The pre-fix module could stack
up to six concurrent open orders of each chemotherapy drug.
TREATMENT (first line). Age <65 and non-indolent: hyper-CVAD (60%) or
bendamustine-rituximab (40%). Age >=65: BR (50%), R-CHOP (30%) or
single-agent ibrutinib (20%). Indolent variant: watch-and-wait with
periodic surveillance visits until progression. Six cycles is the standard
course for each regimen (Rummel MJ et al., Lancet 2013;381:1203 -- BR vs
R-CHOP, 6 cycles q28d; Romaguera JE et al., J Clin Oncol 2005;23:7013 --
R-hyper-CVAD).
TRANSPLANT AND MAINTENANCE. Patients in first remission (CR or PR) aged
under 66 with non-indolent disease are consolidated with autologous stem
cell transplant -- an inpatient admission covering high-dose conditioning,
the stem cell infusion and a 14-21 day stay -- then recover for 3-6 months
and go on to rituximab maintenance. Everyone else in first remission goes
straight to maintenance. Maintenance is up to 18 closed outpatient
rituximab infusions given every 8 weeks (LyMa: Le Gouill S et al., N Engl J
Med 2017;377:1250 -- rituximab maintenance every 2 months for 3 years after
ASCT; Kluin-Nelemans HC et al., N Engl J Med 2012;367:520 -- rituximab
maintenance after R-CHOP in older patients), with a 3% per-cycle relapse
hazard so that maintenance is not an artificial guarantee of remission.
This entire arm was unreachable in the pre-fix module: nothing transitioned
into Consider_Stem_Cell_Transplant, so zero patients ever received an ASCT
or rituximab maintenance.
LATER LINES. Second line: CAR-T (25%, inpatient), acalabrutinib (35%),
venetoclax (25%) or allogeneic transplant (15%). Third line: clinical trial
(monthly closed study visits over 6-18 months), rituximab-gemcitabine
salvage (3-6 closed cycles at 21-28 day intervals) or palliative care.
R-BAC would be the more typical salvage regimen but cytarabine has no
rxnorm_hcpcs_map entry in this tree; likewise BEAM conditioning is
represented by the mapped high-dose cyclophosphamide + etoposide pair,
and CAR-T lymphodepletion by cyclophosphamide alone (fludarabine is
unmapped). End of life is a repeating closed hospice benefit period.
CODING FIXES. The pre-fix module coded three lab draws and two follow-up
lab checks as Procedure states carrying LOINC codes (57021-8, 2532-0,
1952-1) -- LOINC identifies an observable, not a billable procedure, so
none of them could map to HCPCS. They are now SNOMED lab procedures
(104093004 automated CBC with differential, 11274001 LDH measurement,
81410005 beta-2-microglobulin measurement) paired with the LOINC-coded
Observations that carry the results. Bone_Marrow_Biopsy carried 396487001,
which is 'Sentinel lymph node biopsy', not a bone marrow biopsy; it is now
56241004. Autologous_SCT carried 23719005 ('Bone marrow transplant',
unqualified); it is now 58776007 ('Autologous bone marrow transplant').
CT_Chest_Abdomen_Pelvis carried 418891003, which is 'CT of chest and
abdomen' (no pelvis); it is now 418023006. Four Encounter states carried
183616001 ('Follow-up arranged') under four different invented displays
('Chemotherapy treatment plan', 'Targeted therapy treatment plan',
'Clinical trial treatment plan', 'Salvage chemotherapy plan'); those
wrapper encounters are gone. Second_Line_Response carried 182840001
('Drug treatment stopped - medical advice') under the display 'Response to
treatment'; it is now 182985004. Continued_Remission -- the observation
recorded at a CLEAN surveillance visit -- carried the value code 1259237005
'Recurrent malignant neoplasm', exactly inverting its meaning; clean visits
now record 277022003 'Remission phase' and only genuine relapse states
record recurrence.
MCL is a disease of older adults; the annual hazard below is applied
from age 50 onward.
Annual reroll, not a one-shot birth roll: 1.5e-05/yr male, 5e-06/yr
otherwise (population average 1e-05/yr, male:female 3:1).
The delay is jittered 340-390 days so onsets do not synchronise.
Biological onset, months before the patient presents for care.
Conventional, blastoid, pleomorphic and indolent (leukaemic
non-nodal) variants. Blastoid/pleomorphic present faster and behave
more aggressively; indolent disease is watched rather than treated.
SNOMED lab procedure (billable), paired with the LOINC-coded panel
result below. The pre-fix state carried LOINC 57021-8 directly on the
Procedure, which cannot map to HCPCS.

codes.display: Treatment planning for chemotherapy, primary course

remarks: Treatment approach depends on age, performance status and subtype.
R-hyper-CVAD part A is given as an inpatient admission per cycle
(Romaguera JE et al., J Clin Oncol 2005;23:7013). Six cycles.
Bounded length of stay inside the inpatient encounter.
Bendamustine-rituximab, 6 cycles at 28-day intervals
(Rummel MJ et al., Lancet 2013;381:1203).
R-CHOP, 6 cycles at 21-day intervals. Prednisone is a 5-day oral
burst per cycle and is explicitly end-dated after those 5 days, so at
most one prednisone order is ever open at a time.
Attribute guard: the Response_Assessment loop can bring the patient
back through this visit, and ibrutinib is continuous therapy, so it
must not be re-ordered while an order is already open.
Indolent (leukaemic non-nodal) MCL is observed until progression.
The pre-fix module observed these patients with no encounters at all,
so they disappeared from the claims record for years at a time.

remarks: Routes on the mcl_response attribute rather than PriorState: the
response assessment can be revisited several times (stable disease
loops back through it) and a PriorState test never un-fires.
Reachable at last: nothing in the pre-fix module transitioned here,
so zero patients ever received an ASCT or rituximab maintenance.
Marking the evaluation as done keeps a patient who cycles back
through Response_Assessment from being reconsidered for transplant.
Autologous SCT consolidation in first remission is offered to fit
patients under about 65-66 with non-indolent disease; everyone else
goes straight to rituximab maintenance.
Conditioning, stem cell infusion and the aplastic phase all happen
inside one inpatient admission with a bounded 14-21 day stay.
Outpatient recovery with no encounter held open.
Rituximab maintenance, one closed outpatient infusion visit every 8
weeks for up to 18 doses (LyMa, N Engl J Med 2017;377:1250).
3% per 8-week cycle (~17%/yr) so maintenance is not an artificial
guarantee of remission.

remarks: Recorded inside the follow-up visit that detects it, not floating
outside any encounter as in the pre-fix module.
Shared discontinuation router: whichever continuous oral agent is
open gets end-dated before the next line of therapy starts, then
control returns here until none are left. Guarantees at most one open
order of any drug at any time.
Brexucabtagene autoleucel for relapsed/refractory MCL (ZUMA-2, Wang M
et al., N Engl J Med 2020;382:1331): lymphodepletion, infusion and
toxicity monitoring inside one inpatient admission. Lymphodepletion
is cyclophosphamide only -- fludarabine has no rxnorm_hcpcs_map entry.
